title: Rethinking Class Imbalance for Single-Cell Foundation Models: A Systematic Benchmark Across Architectures and Long-Tail Loss Functions
abstract: arXiv:2609.23325v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Single-cell foundation models (scGPT, scBERT, Geneformer) achieve cell-type classification accuracy up to 97.5% in our experiments, yet this aggregate accuracy can mask systematic failure on rare, often disease-relevant cell populations that long-tail loss functions are widely assumed to address. We present a systematic benchmark of six long-tail loss functions (cross-entropy, weighted CE, class-balanced loss, focal loss, LDAM, logit-adjusted softmax) across three architectures and three datasets (Multiple Sclerosis, Zheng68K, human Pancreas), totaling 162 controlled training runs (3 backbones x 3 datasets x 6 losses x 3 seeds). The gap between overall accuracy, Macro-F1, and rare-class recall under plain cross-entropy is consistent across all nine (architecture, dataset) settings, driven by dataset structure rather than pretraining. translated_title: 重新思考单细胞基础模型中的类别不平衡问题：跨架构与长尾损失函数的系统性基准测试
translated_abstract: 单细胞基础模型（scGPT、scBERT、Geneformer）在我们的实验中实现了高达97.5%的细胞类型分类准确率，然而这种总体准确率可能掩盖了模型在罕见且通常与疾病相关的细胞群体上的系统性失败，而长尾损失函数被广泛认为能够解决这一问题。我们提出了一个系统性基准测试，涵盖六种长尾损失函数（交叉熵、加权交叉熵、类别平衡损失、焦点损失、LDAM、logit调整softmax），跨三种架构和三个数据集（多发性硬化症、Zheng68K、人类胰腺），共计162次受控训练运行（3个骨干网络 × 3个数据集 × 6种损失函数 × 3个随机种子）。在普通交叉熵下，总体准确率、Macro-F1与罕见类别召回率之间的差距在所有九种（架构，数据集）设置中保持一致，且该差距由数据集结构而非预训练所驱动。罕见类别的失败本身可划分为两种具有不同嵌入几何特征的模式……
tldr: 该论文通过162次受控训练运行的系统性基准测试发现，单细胞基础模型的高总体准确率掩盖了其在罕见细胞类型上的系统性失败，这一失败由数据集结构而非预训练驱动，且长尾损失函数无法有效解决。
en_tdlr: Through a systematic benchmark of 162 controlled training runs, this paper reveals that the high overall accuracy of single-cell foundation models masks systematic failures on rare cell types, which are driven by dataset structure rather than pretraining and cannot be resolved by long-tail loss functions.
